title: A WordPress band the page keeps (keepScopes) keeps its own buttons under a worn system: the variation's primary-button and accent-text rules stop at its edge, so Tracy Business's orange hero and closing-call buttons stay orange; its contract probes the header's call to action
steps: S1: From packages/design/tracy-ds-slot run: node --test --test-reporter=tap test/cms.test.mjs test/tokenize.test.mjs
S2: Record the exit code, '# fail' and the results of the two tests named in expect.
expect: 'WordPress: a kept band keeps its own buttons — the system’s colour rules stop at its edge' is ok: in the Moxie variation for templates/wordpress-tracy-business.json, every selector of the primary-button rule (background-color var(--wp--preset--color--accent)) and of both accent-text rules (color #hex!important) ends in :not(.tracy-topbar, .tracy-topbar *, .wtb-hero, .wtb-hero *, .wtb-cta, .wtb-cta *, .tracy-footer, .tracy-footer *), with ::after kept last; the button shape rule still reaches every button; the tracy-base variation (no kept band) carries no such exclusion.
'a slot colour rule stops at every kept band; a pseudo-element stays last; no band, no change' is ok (outsideKept in src/tokens56.mjs).

selectors.rule: src/wordpress.mjs styles.css: sel.buttonPrimary, sel.accentText, sel.accentTextHover through outsideKept(contract)

evidence: tasks/evidence/followups-2026-10-10/p6-dsdata (README §2): pass-wordpress.mjs tracy-business on the restored tracy-business/wp7 release, 10/10/2026 — with the slot code of 977cbb3e6 the hero's and closing call's orange buttons computed rgb(20, 72, 58) and the hero's outline button a filled rgb(20, 72, 58) under all four systems; with the fix they compute their default (rgb(218, 90, 42); transparent) under all four, 8/12 verdicts, controls 0.
fence: the WordPress variation's colour rules and Tracy Business's contract; the Joomla module sheet's are REG-PR-1100-p6-joomla-kept-band-keeps-its-buttons

tests: WordPress: a kept band keeps its own buttons — the system’s colour rules stop at its edge
a slot colour rule stops at every kept band; a pseudo-element stays last; no band, no change
